name: datasource-sharepoint
description: SharePoint Online data source using application permissions (Files.Read.All + Sites.Read.All)
_comment: Uses APPLICATION permissions (client credentials) – the indexer runs as the application service principal.
The app registration must have Application permissions: Files.Read.All + Sites.Read.All on Microsoft Graph.
Tenant admin consent is required for these permissions.
Replace placeholder values ({{...}}) before deployment or use deploy_search.py
